body: 2026-10-16. A login's token is either pasted and stored (tokens.yaml), produced by any command (token_cmd, e.g. a secret-manager CLI), or read from an env var (token_env). No secret manager is required and no new secret-ref scheme is added: token_cmd covers every store. Why: a machine may not have the owner's secret manager; one mechanism instead of two.
title: Logins D3/D10: token source optional per login (stored, token_cmd, token_env)
